# Burst Hot Water Tank Damage — Exclusion Under "Accidental Damage" Cover

Based on the policy excerpts provided, here is the relevant exclusion:

## Current Exclusion Wording (as amended by SPDS)

Under the "Accidental damage" optional cover (both Home & Contents and Landlord policies), the "We don't cover" section excludes:

> "of repairing or replacing **items that explode, burst, or leak**, such as a hot water tank bursting or leaking" [Suncorp Landlord SPDS, page 1] [Suncorp Contents SPDS, page 1]

## Important Update

This wording **replaces** the original PDS exclusion, which was narrower and read:

> "of repairing or replacing **tanks or containers that burst or leak**, such as a hot water tank bursting or leaking" [Suncorp Landlord PDS, page 79]

The SPDS explicitly states this change applies to:
- Page 79 of the Landlord PDS [Suncorp Landlord SPDS, page 1]
- Page 75 of the Home & Contents PDS [Suncorp Contents SPDS, page 1]

## What This Means

The amended (current) exclusion is broader than the original — it now excludes damage from **any items that explode, burst, or leak** (not just "tanks or containers"), using a bursting/leaking hot water tank as the illustrative example. Since an SPDS overrides the PDS where they conflict, **this broader wording is the current operative exclusion**.

## Limitation on the Excerpts

The excerpts provided only show the "We don't cover" exclusion for **Accidental Damage** cover specifically. They do not include:
- The general policy sections on hot water system/tank damage (e.g., under standard "Damage" or "Escape of liquid" sections, if separate from Accidental Damage)
- Any policy limits, sub-limits, or excess amounts specific to hot water systems
- Whether hot water tank bursting might be covered under a different section of the policy (e.g., a standard "sudden and accidental" damage clause outside the Accidental Damage optional cover)

If you need to know whether burst hot water tank damage is covered *elsewhere* in the policy (outside this specific exclusion), please provide those additional excerpts.

## Coverage for Escape of Liquid

Both the Suncorp Contents and Landlord policies provide cover for **sudden and unexpected loss or damage caused by liquid escaping** from specified sources, including fixed tanks and fixed pipes (excluding those forming part of a shower floor, base, or cubicle wall, and excluding overflow drains/pipes) [Suncorp Contents PDS, page 47; Suncorp Landlord PDS, page 53].

The policies also extend this to **gradual loss or damage** from the same sources, where the damage occurring "wasn't easily visible to a reasonable person in the circumstances" [Suncorp Contents PDS, page 47; Suncorp Landlord PDS, page 53].
